source: Independent RuntimeInput behavior QA reported by Wild Crown Luna input behavior verification
module: src/input/RuntimeInput.ts served through the existing Vite module
method: Chromium with Playwright keyboard input helpers; button tests used a synthetic connected gamepad. Keyboard events exercised the RuntimeInput module, not direct DOM clicks.

results.shortTap: With the input enabled, key j down+up between sample calls produced lightPressed=true once; the next sample produced false. Repeated keydown did not add another press.
results.heavyEdges: Heavy press sample reported heavyPressed=true and heavyHeld=true. Key release reported heavyReleased=true. Gamepad disconnect while heavy was held also reported heavyReleased=true.
results.movement: W+D normalized to moveX=0.70710678, moveZ=0.70710678; opposed W+S yielded (0,0).
results.remappedCommandWheel: Keyboard moveRight remapped to l and commandWheel to x; after a 100 ms hold and release, the wheel reported commandIndex=4.
results.browserDefault: moveForward remapped to PageDown; the key event was defaultPrevented=true and scrollY stayed 0. Default Space also prevented default and produced dodgePressed=true.
results.independentDeviceMaps: Keyboard dodge=f continued to work with the default gamepad Dodge button 1. Setting the explicit gamepad Dodge binding to Button 2 stopped Button 1 and accepted Button 2, while keyboard f remained active.
results.deadzone: Synthetic pad axis magnitude 0.1 yielded 0; magnitude 0.5 yielded 0.3902439.
results.disableAndReenable: setEnabled(false) while heavy was held cleared input; re-enabling while the held key remained down stayed empty until key-up and a fresh key-down.

notVerified: Actual hardware gamepad behavior (only a synthetic connected pad was used).

Real browser window blur, document visibilitychange, or BFCache navigation; automation attempts did not produce those browser lifecycle events. Do not infer those paths from the explicit setEnabled check.
Full campaign gameplay; required real verified assets remain a separate gate.
observationNote: An earlier broad harness run reported one transient HTTP 500 console resource error; the later focused follow-up reported errors=[]. This evidence preserves both observations rather than treating the transient error as absent.
